scope: R144 single receive-allocation caller Oracle screen; fixed C/R136 daemons, no router adoption
primary: For each daemon separately, each block has an equal-weight geometric mean of the three lane new/old mean ratios. Both daemons require the six-block median strictly below 0.99 and at least five geometric ratios below one.
latency_veto: Any of 2 daemons x 3 lanes x 3 latency metrics rejects when the six-block paired new/old ratio median is strictly above 1.03 and all six ratios exceed one.
numeric: Raw metrics and individual ratios use exact Fraction values. Each geometric mean uses 60-digit Decimal arithmetic, quantized to 30 decimal places before median and strict comparisons.
interpretation: Inclusive plus/minus 1% is unresolved, never equivalence. This is an Oracle engineering screen without significance or router acceptance claims. CPU cannot rescue failed latency gates; provider CPU is not included in daemon/caller CPU metrics.
stopping: One frozen new caller, one distinct 12-case functional smoke, then exactly 72 formal cases. Preserve failures and all cases; no selected blocks, retraining, retries, extra samples or candidate selection after seeing timing.
